tests.stimulus: Use known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Start from independently asserted and released core/falcon resets, and establish nonempty state only through accepted request/event history. Assert both resets at startup and while events are pending; independently reset the core and falcon domains at midstream with clocks running, observe asynchronous windows, then resume requests.
tests.expected: Each reset clears only its stated domain immediately. Core response valid/data and logical pending state reset to zero. Falcon reset clears core_intr immediately while preserving core status for later propagation.
tests.checker: A self-contained native-port model predicts only from input request history, abstract mask/pending-event sets and independent clock histories. DUT and predicted outputs have separate wires. The monitor compares every output, including held response data, one nanosecond after each rising core/falcon edge and after asynchronous reset assertion. Four-state inequality produces UVM_ERROR; finite sequence and mandatory comparison/event counts reject vacuity.
